9.7.13. Control Flow Instructions
The following PTX instructions and syntax are for controlling execution in a PTX program:
{}
@
bra
call
ret
exit
context_before: 21785-21787: end of section 9.7.12.4 (suq) content and its parent section 9.7.12
reason_for_inclusion: Establishes section 9.7.13 (Control Flow Instructions) as the general control-flow/predication section of PTX ISA 9.3 and lists @ among the control-flow constructs; this section contains the explicit false-guard no-op clause (9.7.13.2).
